items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Joseph Marsala Mary McPartland, and Mary Osborne, they were over there a lot you know.

ctx.x: Ben grabs Charlie and pulled him out of the booth and started to slapping him around the place. I say heh, Ben, don't do that man. Say I know you, John Simmons, you ready to fight. You've been known to whip everybody. Everybody your size. I got something for you. So he come out of his handkerchief pocket in his coat with a straight edge razor. And we're standing at the bar. He say I got something for you. Well the police, plain clothesman, let their presence be known. They was fixing to rap his head with the…

start arguing. He say look, Ben, you in my premises. I can kill you right here and nothing will happen. So Ben give him the razor. He says, on second thought, get out anyway and come back and get your razor when you get off from work, you know. See you going to upset the place anyway. You've had too many to drink. And I reserve the right to refuse you, you know so go on out.

So I got back on the job. I say hah, Ben, I say you do that shit to Charlie, I say you'll do it to me too. I say and if you do, man, I'll take a killing, but I ain't going to take no whipping. I say as large as you are, you know. There's no way. He mumbled something, you know. Gazed off into space, like he hasn't even heard me, you know. Well, I was ready for him. Never carried a knife, but I pulled my own coat. I say I'm getting so wild with this fighting, I . I won more fights on 52nd street than Sugar Ray did…
